text: APPROVE: The inner loop body moved unchanged into `AddGoEmbedRef`, with each `continue` becoming an equivalent `return`. That drops the nested early-exit branches from `CollectGoEmbedRefs`, which should bring it below 15. The new helper is private and static and uses all its parameters, so I see no reason for a build warning. I could not check the parameter types (`List<HostEmbedRef>`, string `directory`) against the original signature, since the diff doesn't show it.
